exact_results: An explicit equivalence identifies actual Fin(d+1) finitely supported exponents w with (w_0, tail(w)) in Nat times (Fin d -> Nat).

The total-degree map is w_0 plus the sum of tail exponents. Its fiber at n is proved equal to the actual finite index set using the existing membership theorem.
The original HasSum is transported through the equivalence, then HasSum.tsum_fiberwise is applied with established summability. Each finite fiber tsum equals its finite sum by Finset.tsum_subtype.
The final polynomial identity follows by applying actual evaluation to the literal finite sum and using the already proved exact single-term evaluation formula.
Summability is a premise on the original product-index term family. The grouping equality, grouping convergence and output sum are conclusions, not assumed premises.
No homogeneity hypothesis is needed merely to regroup; grouping remains valid in degree zero, zero spectator dimension and zero-coefficient cases.
